narrative: A naval mine explosion on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz dominates weekend news, setting up a geopolitical risk premium and crude-driven support for energy currencies at the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1206, where a +143bp OIS carry advantage favors the dollar and reinforces downside pressure into the new week. USD/JPY closed Friday at 158.25, likely to test higher on the broader dollar bid ahead of the Bank of Japan's rate decision later this month.
